fields.name: Employment Services · Sugarhouse Job-Search Help
fields.description: Work with an adviser on resumes, job leads and interviews. Phone or video coaching is also available.
fields.address: 724 E 2100 S, Suite A, Salt Lake City, UT 84106

informationSections.programsAndServices: Individual job-search coaching, resume help, interview practice and networking. Computers and printers are available.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: Everyone is welcome; Church membership is not required.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Call the center to check current hours. Walk-ins are welcome; an appointment is encouraged. Request Assistance on the website also connects you with an adviser.
informationSections.access: Sugarhouse in Salt Lake City. Phone or video coaching is available if you cannot visit.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: Bring a resume or job description if you have one. You can still get help without either.

items.summary: Official sources support this proposed referral; practical restrictions are retained.

fields.name: PeopleReady · Salt Lake City Staffing
fields.description: Apply for temporary and other local work. Job availability and requirements vary.
fields.address: 1081 S 300 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84115

informationSections.programsAndServices: Staffing for short-term, longer-term and permanent jobs in several industries.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: Requirements depend on the job. Ask the branch what identification, skills and work authorization documents are needed.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Call the Salt Lake City branch for application help or use JobStack to look for assignments.
informationSections.access: Salt Lake City branch; check the actual work site and transportation before accepting a job.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: An application does not guarantee a shift. Confirm pay, schedule, equipment needs and any costs before accepting.

items.summary: Distinct disability employment route, independently confirmed; waiting restrictions preserved.

fields.name: Utah Vocational Rehabilitation · Disability Job Support
fields.description: Help getting and keeping a job for people whose disability makes working difficult. Offices around Utah including the Salt Lake area; part of the Utah Department of Workforce Services.

informationSections.programsAndServices: Work with a counselor on a plan to get or keep a job. Services depend on your needs, eligibility and available funding.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: A disability must substantially affect work, and you must need and benefit from rehabilitation services. A counselor decides eligibility, usually within 60 days of your appointment; some cases take longer.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Call 866-454-8397 for your local VR office. Obtain an application and arrange a counselor appointment. Bring identification, your Social Security card and any disability records; staff can arrange an evaluation if records are missing.
informationSections.access: Salt Lake area and statewide. Spanish and large-print applications are available. You may bring someone to your appointment.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: Some newly eligible applicants must wait for training or job placement; existing employment plans continue. People waiting receive information and referrals. Ask about current availability and any costs before making plans.

items.summary: Confirmed free local adult support with direct intake; language, course time and referral limits retained.

fields.name: Utah Community Action · Job Help, GED and Career Training
fields.description: Free classes and one-to-one help for adults who want to find work, earn more, or finish their education. For adults living in Salt Lake or Tooele counties; office on 900 West in Salt Lake City.
fields.address: 1307 S 900 W, Salt Lake City, UT

informationSections.programsAndServices: Free job-readiness and money-management help, GED preparation and a child-care credential. Staff also refer people to English classes and other training.
informationSections.eligibilityRequirements: Age 18 or older and living in Salt Lake or Tooele County. All income levels are welcome. The child-care credential has additional qualifications.
informationSections.howToBestConnect: Call 801-359-2444 and ask for Workforce Development, or complete the website’s English or Spanish form. Staff follow up to finish the application by phone.
informationSections.access: The listed office is at 1307 S 900 W. Ask where your classes or appointments will take place before traveling.
informationSections.importantInformationToKnow: GED preparation is currently in English and includes exam fees. The child-care credential requires 120 class hours plus 480 preschool hours. Services reached through referrals may have different costs and requirements.
